# P2 Small Portable Seed

This compact fixture was generated by `p2-catalog-generator@1.0` from authored synthetic text. It contains no copied paper content or private workspace data.

The committed fixture is intentionally uninitialized. Core workspace identity binds resolved paths, so `.research-kb/workspace.json` and the lock file are created only after the seed is copied to an absent temporary target and passed through `WorkspaceBootstrapService`.

Regeneration flow:

```powershell
python -m benchmarks.p2_catalog_scale generate --profile p2-small --target <absolute-absent-temp-target>
python -m benchmarks.p2_catalog_scale export-small --source-target <absolute-temp-target>
```

`export-small` refuses an existing fixture target. Regeneration therefore requires a separately reviewed replacement operation; it never overwrites this committed seed in place.
